objects: Weather limits tightened card on wire
actions: 43.0 to 43.4 s static row of cars with the card on the wire
at 43.6 s the camera moves in and shifts to a low angle on the lead car so it becomes large at left and the row recedes toward the right
text: As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits,
and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.
observed: Frames 43.0 to 43.8 s. First three frames repeat the parked row with the hanging Weather limits card. At 43.6 s the view changes to a close, lower angle: the lead white car is large at left with passenger silhouettes in the windows, the other cars shrink in a line to the right, trees and a skyline behind, the wire card bigger at the top left. Caption becomes and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. Lower area is wet asphalt with reflections.
